|game_text=If your character's forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. (Immune to [[Sense]].) OR Cancel an attempt to 'operate' on a character (who is also protected from any further attempts until start of opponent's next turn). OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-95-Odin_Nesloor_First_Aid.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “If your character’s forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. [Immune to Sense] OR Cancel an attempt to ‘operate’ on a character (who is also protected from any further attempts until start of opponent’s next turn). OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to ‘transport’ (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to ‘transport,’ or place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=13 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 13, slip 95. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=13 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 35). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=35, page 35. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=35 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “95” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) changed “free if reduced by” to “free if forfeit reduced by”, “a character (who is also protected … next turn)” to “a character; character is protected … next turn” and “place this Interrupt” to “place Interrupt”: “If your character's forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if forfeit reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel an attempt to 'operate' on a character; character is protected from any further attempts until start of opponent's next turn. OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.”.<ref name="cl-1261_105-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-odinnesloor&firstaid-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “If your character’s forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. [Immune to Sense] OR Cancel an attempt to ‘operate’ on a character (who is also protected from any further attempts until start of opponent’s next turn). OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to ‘transport’ (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to ‘transport,’ or place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “95” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 35)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “If your character’s forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. [Immune to Sense] OR Cancel an attempt to ‘operate’ on a character (who is also protected from any further attempts until start of opponent’s next turn). OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to ‘transport’ (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to ‘transport,’ or place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-105-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “95”). The release-sheet slip and the PC card image show only the Odin Nesloor art; the Master List slip shows the two-card split art (Odin Nesloor and First Aid).
